openmontage.newOmissions: Four README preview screenshots under docs/images/backlot and one unreferenced example Logo; the three previously omitted demonstration MP4 files remain omitted.
openmontage.retained: All2163 remaining paths, bytes and executable permission semantics match the original pinned source. Runtime code, Skills, templates, audio, textures, fonts, examples and tests remain; duplicate assets keep independent regular-file paths without symlinks/hardlinks.
openmontage.documentationBoundary: Retained upstream README files may still reference intentionally omitted preview PNGs. Their original source is identified in provenance; runtime code does not consume these preview files.
openmontage.compression: XZ uses a32MiB dictionary to compress repeated bytes without deleting duplicated skill/audio paths or changing write semantics. Local gzip-versus-XZ measurements do not establish universal build/render speed.
openmontage.extraction: External Pythonstdlib helper verifies compressed SHA and128MiB limit, complete compressed stream CRC/footer,64MiB XZ decoder memory cap,512MiB unpacked-content and100k-entry limits, a single expected root, ordinary files/directories and safe nonaliased paths before installing a private staged tree with readable0755 directories. gzip compatibility remains.
openmontage.dependencies: No xz system executable or extra APT download is introduced. Python already exists in the common tool base. Existing pip/Remotion/HyperFrames dependencies remain ahead of integration overlays in Docker layers.
openmontage.provenance: upstream/source-bundle.json retains original archive pin, every preserved file hash/size/mode, compression parameters and exact omission reasons; local-only repacker reproduces the shipped bundle.
